title: A C¹ map near a compact set agrees there with a compactly supported C¹ perturbation of the identity (the cut-off of Simon 6.2.23)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝ^P open, K ⊆ O compact, and f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on O (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O). Then there exist a map φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on all of ℝ^P (ContDiff ℝ 1 φ), an open set V ⊆ ℝ^P with K ⊆ V, and a compact set K' ⊆ ℝ^P such that φ(x) = f(x) and Dφ(x) = Df(x) for every x ∈ V (Df(x) := fderiv ℝ f x), and φ(x) = x for every x ∉ K'.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → ∃ (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (V K' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ IsCompact K' ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, φ x = f x ∧ fderiv ℝ φ x = fderiv ℝ f x) ∧ ∀ x, x ∉ K' → φ x = x
